digest.en: A Pakistan judge's killing has sparked a dispute over jurisdiction, with Indian officials weighing in on the matter, while the US and China have yet to comment. Meanwhile, the wildfire crisis in France and Spain continues to worsen, with over 2,000 firefighters deployed to combat the flames. In Singapore, the Land Transport Authority has proposed merging COE categories A and B as part of its transport plan consultations.
